def transform2(g):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[(c,ce) for c,ce in comps(g) if c!=0 and c!=bg]
    zrs=zero_regions(g)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if not objs: return out
    mx=max(len(e) for c,e in objs)
    top=[(c,e) for c,e in objs if len(e)==mx]
    # tiebreak: fewest comps of that color, then smallest total area
    def nc(c): return sum(1 for cc,_ in objs if cc==c)
    def tot(c): return sum(len(e) for cc,e in objs if cc==c)
    best=min(top,key=lambda t:(nc(t[0]),tot(t[0]),t[0]))
    C=best[0]
    # fill clause: a zero region matching the size of a comp of C
    match=[z for z in zrs if len(z)==len(best[1])]
    if match:
        z=min(match,key=lambda z:(z[0],z[1]))
        for y,x in z: out[y][x]=C
    else:
        cs=[e for c,e in objs if c==C]
        tgt=min(cs,key=lambda e:(e[0],e[1]))
        for y,x in tgt: out[y][x]=0
    return out

    s=shape_of(cells)

    _,bl,al=s
    # find corner: cell where bar row and arm col intersect; arms' directions
    rs=Counter(r for r,c in cells); cs=Counter(c for r,c in cells)

    if (barrow,armcol) not in set(cells): return None

def quadrant_of_L(cells):
    li=Linfo(cells)
    _,bl,al=li
    rs=Counter(r for r,c in cells); cs=Counter(c for r,c in cells)
    barrow=max(rs,key=lambda r:rs[r]); armcol=max(cs,key=lambda c:cs[c])
    cr,cc=barrow,armcol
    dr='R' if max(c for r,c in cells if r==cr)>cc else 'L'
    dv='D' if max(r for r,c in cells if c==cc)>cr else 'U'
    # aiming quadrant = opposite both arms
    rr=(-1,cr) if dv=='D' else (cr+1,10**6)  # aims up if arm goes down
    ccc=(cc+1,10**6) if dr=='L' else (-1,cc) # aims right if bar goes left
    return (rr,ccc),(dr,dv)
def inq(cells,q):
    (r0,r1),(c0,c1)=q
    inq=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if r0<=r<r1 and c0<=c<c1]
    return ('all' if len(inq)==len(cells) else 'part') if inq else 'no'
for k,p in enumerate(d):
    gi=p['input']; go=p['output']
    bgc=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ch={(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]}
    cps=[(col,cells) for col,cells in comps2(gi) if not (col==bgc and len(cells)>30)]
    Ls=sorted([(len(cells),col,cells) for col,cells in cps if Linfo(cells)],reverse=True)
    mcol,mcells=Ls[0][1],Ls[0][2]
    q,_=quadrant_of_L(mcells)
    tgt=[(col,cells) for col,cells in cps if any(c in ch for c in cells)][0]
    # congruence classes
    classes={}
    for i,(col,cells) in enumerate(cps):
        placed=False
        for key in classes:
            if len(cells)==len(classes[key][0][1]) and congruent(cells,classes[key][0][1]):
                classes[key].append((col,cells)); placed=True; break
        if not placed: classes[len(classes)] = [(col,cells)]
    print('=== demo',k,'marker color',mcol,'q',q,'target',tgt[0],len(tgt[1]),bbox(tgt[1]))
    for key,mem in classes.items():
        if len(mem)>1:
            print('  set n=%d:'%len(mem[0][1]), [(c,bbox(cl),inq(cl,q)) for c,cl in mem])

import math
def feat_table(gi,go):
    bgc=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ch={(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]}
    cps=[(col,cells) for col,cells in comps2(gi)]
    Ls=sorted([(len(cells),col,cells) for col,cells in cps if Linfo(cells)],reverse=True)
    mcol,mcells=Ls[0][1],Ls[0][2]
    q,_=quadrant_of_L(mcells)
    (r0,r1),(c0,c1)=q
    cr,cc=None,None
    rs=Counter(r for r,c in mcells); cs=Counter(c for r,c in mcells)
    cr=max(rs,key=lambda r:rs[r]); cc=max(cs,key=lambda c:cs[c])
    mset=set(mcells)
    # congruence classes
    classes=[]
    for col,cells in cps:
        for mem in classes:
            if len(cells)==len(mem[0][1]) and congruent(cells,mem[0][1]):
                mem.append((col,cells)); break
        else: classes.append([(col,cells)])
    cls_of={}
    for i,mem in enumerate(classes):
        for j,(col,cells) in enumerate(mem): cls_of[(i,j)]=(i,len(mem))
    rows=[]
    for i,(col,cells) in enumerate(cps):
        ci,csz=cls_of[(i,[k for k,(c2,cl) in enumerate(classes[i]) if cl==cells][0])] if False else (None,None)
        rows.append((col,cells))
    def mind_to(cellsA,cellsB): return min(abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1]) for a in cellsA for b in cellsB)
    out=[]
    for i,(col,cells) in enumerate(cps):
        mem=classes[i]; csz=len(mem)
        mates_out=sum(1 for c2,cl in mem if cl!=cells and inq(cl,q)=='no')
        inq_s=inq(cells,q)
        mcell=(sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells), sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells))
        dr=mcell[0]-cr; dc=mcell[1]-cc
        f=dict(col=col,size=len(cells),csz=csz,mates_out=mates_out,inq=inq_s,
               dmin=mind_to(cells,mcells), dcorner=min(abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc) for r,c in cells),
               dr=dr,dc=dc, iszero=col==0, isbg=col==bgc, isL=bool(Linfo(cells)),
               dmax=max(abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc) for r,c in cells),
               perp=abs(dr-dc)/math.sqrt(2))
        istgt=any(c in ch for c in cells)
        out.append((istgt,f,cells))
    return out,(mcol,mcells,q),ch
for k,p in enumerate(d):
    T,minfo,ch=feat_table(p['input'],p['output'])

import itertools
# Build full per-demo data: marker (largest L), comps, classes, features
data=[]
for pi,dd in enumerate(D):
    gi,go=dd['input'],dd['output']
    Rg,Wg=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cps_=[(col,cells) for col,cells in comps2(gi)]
    changed={(r,c) for r in range(Rg) for c in range(Wg) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]}
    # marker: largest L
    Ls_=[(col,cells) for col,cells in cps_ if Linfo(cells)]
    mcol,mcells=max(Ls_,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    nonmark=[(col,cells) for col,cells in cps_ if (col,cells)!=(mcol,mcells)]
    # classes
    cls=[]
    for col,cells in nonmark:
        for mem in cls:
            if len(cells)==len(mem[0][1]) and congruent(cells,mem[0][1]): mem.append((col,cells)); break
        else: cls.append([(col,cells)])
    dm=lambda cells: min(abs(r-r2)+abs(c-c2) for r,c in cells for r2,c2 in mcells)
    classes=[]
    for mem in cls:
        if len(mem)<2: continue
        mems=[dict(col=col,cells=cells,size=len(cells),dmin=dm(cells),tgt=bool(set(cells)&changed)) for col,cells in mem]
        # separation
        a,b=mems[0]['cells'],mems[1]['cells']
        sep=min(abs(r1_-r2_)+abs(c1_-c2_) for r1_,c1_ in a for r2_,c2_ in b)
        cen=lambda cl:((min(r for r,c in cl)+max(r for r,c in cl))/2,(min(c for r,c in cl)+max(c for r,c in cl))/2)
        ca,cb=cen(a),cen(b)
        classes.append(dict(mems=mems,sep=sep,ca=ca,cb=cb,n=len(mems),
            sizes=[m['size'] for m in mems],cols=[m['col'] for m in mems],
            dmins=[m['dmin'] for m in mems],tgt=any(m['tgt'] for m in mems)))
    # marker geometry: arms
    bl,al,adirs,_=Linfo(mcells)
    r0,c0=min(r for r,c in mcells),min(c for r,c in mcells)
    r1,c1=max(r for r,c in mcells),max(c for r,c in mcells)
    aims=[]
    for ad in adirs:
        aims.append({'L':'c<','R':'c>','U':'r<','D':'r>'}[ad])
    data.append(dict(pi=pi,bg=bgc,mcol=mcol,mcells=mcells,classes=classes,aims=aims,
        r0=r0,c0=c0,r1=r1,c1=c1,R=Rg,W=Wg,changed=changed))
    print(f"demo{pi} bg={bgc} marker color={mcol} size={len(mcells)} arms={adirs} aims={aims} corner=({r0},{c0}) nclasses={len(classes)}")
    for cl in classes:
        print('   class:',[(m['col'],m['size'],round(m['dmin'],1),'TGT' if m['tgt'] else '') for m in cl['mems']],'sep',cl['sep'])

import json, numpy as np
from collections import Counter, deque

def comps_of(g, bg=None):
    g = np.array(g); H,W = g.shape
    if bg is None: bg = Counter(g.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if (i,j) in seen: continue
            v=g[i,j]; stk=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cs=[]
            while stk:
                r,c=stk.pop(); cs.append((r,c))
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    r1,c1=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=r1<H and 0<=c1<W and (r1,c1) not in seen and g[r1,c1]==v:
                        seen.add((r1,c1)); stk.append((r1,c1))
            out.append((v,cs))
    return out, bg

def L_marker(c):
    """return (corner, rect) if comp is a pure 2-segment L else None"""
    rs=[r for r,_ in c]; cs=[c_ for _,c_ in c]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    h=abs(r1-r0)+1; w=abs(c1-c0)+1
    # pure L: exactly one full horizontal run and one full vertical run sharing an endpoint
    rows=Counter(rs); cols=Counter(cs)
    hr=[r for r,n in rows.items() if n==w]
    vr=[c_ for c_,n in cols.items() if n==h]
    if len(hr)!=1 or len(vr)!=1: return None
    R,C_=hr[0],vr[0]
    if (R,C_) not in set(c): return None
    if len(c)!=h+w-1: return None
    return (R,C_),(min(R,r0+r1-R),min(C_,c0+c1-C_))  # corner, opposite corner of rect

def norm_cells(cells):
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    return frozenset((r-min(rs), c-min(cs)) for r,c in cells)

def transform(grid):
    g=np.array(grid); H,W=g.shape
    cl,bg=comps_of(g)
    markers=[(v,c) for v,c in cl if v!=bg and L_marker(c)]
    out=[list(row) for row in g]
    for mv,mc in markers:
        info=L_marker(mc)
        if not info: continue
        (R,C),(R2,C2)=info
        rect=set((r,c) for r in range(min(R,R2),max(R,R2)+1)
                          for c in range(min(C,C2),max(C,C2)+1))
        mset=set(mc)
        # pocket comps: comps fully inside rect, not the marker
        inside=[(v,c) for v,c in cl if (v,c)!=(mv,mc) and set(c)<=rect and set(c)!=mset]
        if not inside: continue

def sym_keys(cells):
    cs=[np.array([r,c]) for r,c in cells]
    out=set()
    for M in D8:
        pts=frozenset(tuple(int(x) for x in (M@p)) for p in cs)

        mr,mc=min(rs),min(cs_)
        out.add(frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in pts))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=np.array(grid); H,W=g.shape
    cl,bgc_=comps_of(g)
    out=[list(row) for row in g]
    changes=[]
    for mv,mc in cl:
        if mv==bgc_: continue
        rs=[r for r,_ in mc]; cs=[c for _,c in mc]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        if len(mc)!=h+w-1 or h<2 or w<2: continue   # pure nondegenerate L
        rows=Counter(rs); cols=Counter(cs)
        if sum(1 for x in rows.values() if x==w)!=1 or sum(1 for x in cols.values() if x==h)!=1: continue
        R=[r for r,x in rows.items() if x==w][0]; C=[c for c,x in cols.items() if x==h][0]
        if (R,C) not in set(mc): continue
        rect=set((r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
